title: Alibaba Cloud AgentLoop's Three Features Will Be Billed Starting December 7
excerpt: Those capabilities that let AI remember you and get smoother the more you use them are about to enter the billing list. On November 23, Alibaba Cloud announced
content_html:
Those capabilities that let AI remember you and get smoother the more you use them are about to enter the billing list. On November 23, Alibaba Cloud announced that AgentLoop will begin charging for three functions—memory store, experience store, and optimization tasks—starting at 0:00 Beijing time on December 7, 2026, with the model resource consumption incurred billed according to the actual consumption of AI Credits.

Three functions, all about "getting smarter the more you use them"

Looking at the names alone, they seem a bit abstract, but they actually point to the same thing: letting agents break through the limitation of a "single conversation." The memory store uses models to extract long-term memory that can span sessions from data such as conversations—preferences discussed today can still be picked up next time. The experience store analyzes an Agent's execution traces and distills completed tasks into reusable experience, so similar work does not have to be figured out from scratch. Optimization tasks tune Agent assets such as prompts and skills, which is equivalent to continuous training. Only when the three are combined can an Agent change from a "forgetful one-off assistant" into a "long-term employee with accumulated experience"—and from now on, that accumulation will be billed item by item according to Token consumption.

Billing equals usage, keep an eye on your budget yourself

The billing method is not a monthly subscription, but settlement based on actual AI Credits consumption—however many resources are used, that much quota is deducted. All three functions continuously consume model calls in the background, so for agents that run for a long time, costs will accumulate with usage duration.

Alibaba Cloud reminds users to check the usage of the relevant functions in advance and set a budget according to business needs. For developers, the period before December 7 is a good time to take stock of which memories and experiences are worth keeping and paying for, and which can be streamlined to save Credits.
